description: IDEATHON 2026 – Where Ideas Turn Into Innovation! Organised by e~people.org – The Computer Science Society, Ram Lal Anand College, University of Delhi , in collaboration with the IT Skill Centre for Information & Technology , IDEATHON 2026 is a one-day technology-focused innovation event where creativity meets technology. Do you have ideas that can solve real-world problems? Here’s your chance to turn them into something meaningful! Participants will be given a problem statement on the spot, based on which they will develop an innovative solution using AI tools and other available technologies. The challenge is to transform an idea into a working prototype, such as a website, app, or other tech-based solution, within a limited time. The event journey includes: Ideation: Understand the problem and develop a creative solution. ️ Prototype Development: Build your solution using AI tools and other technologies Final Presentation: Present your solution to a panel of judges for evaluation. Prizes Worth ₹3,250 1st Prize: ₹1,500 2nd Prize: ₹1,000 3rd Prize: ₹750 Date: 15 October 2026 (Thursday) Time: 11:30 AM onwards Venue: PC-16, Ram Lal Anand College, University of Delhi Whether you're a developer, designer, creative thinker, or someone with a passion for innovation, IDEATHON 2026 is your opportunity to learn, experiment, collaborate, and build something impactful. Think. Build. Solve. Innovate. Turn your ideas into reality! Register now and be a part of the innovation journey!

raw.details:
IDEATHON 2026 – Where Ideas Turn Into Innovation!

Organised by e~people.org – The Computer Science Society, Ram Lal Anand College, University of Delhi, in collaboration with the IT Skill Centre for Information & Technology, IDEATHON 2026 is a one-day technology-focused innovation event where creativity meets technology.

Do you have ideas that can solve real-world problems? Here’s your chance to turn them into something meaningful!

Participants will be given a problem statement on the spot, based on which they will develop an innovative solution using AI tools and other available technologies. The challenge is to transform an idea into a working prototype, such as a website, app, or other tech-based solution, within a limited time.

The event journey includes:

  • Ideation: Understand the problem and develop a creative solution.
  • ️ Prototype Development: Build your solution using AI tools and other technologies
  • Final Presentation: Present your solution to a panel of judges for evaluation.

Prizes Worth ₹3,250

  • 1st Prize: ₹1,500
  • 2nd Prize: ₹1,000
  • 3rd Prize: ₹750

Date: 15 October 2026 (Thursday)
Time: 11:30 AM onwards
Venue: PC-16, Ram Lal Anand College, University of Delhi

Whether you're a developer, designer, creative thinker, or someone with a passion for innovation, IDEATHON 2026 is your opportunity to learn, experiment, collaborate, and build something impactful.

Think. Build. Solve. Innovate. Turn your ideas into reality!

Register now and be a part of the innovation journey!
